verdict.rationale: Lithic is a card-issuing API platform with SDKs and an official MCP server, so whether users can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question. The evidence covers the MCP server, authorization rules, webhooks, sandbox and KYC, but nothing documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out, so the axis applies and is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
